summary: Source changes do not refresh the installed learning outline when the reader is closed.
fix: Publish the accepted baseline/progress projection or fire the tree invalidation after every successful baseline update, independently of opening the reader; keep native source rendering conditional. Verify the outline refresh event while opened is false.
evidence: The watcher calls 'this.readBaselines().then(() => this.renderSelection())' at line 407 (the document-change branch does the same at line 403), but renderSelection line 311 returns for '!this.opened'. close line 213 sets opened=false while the outline remains registered. The only 'this.treeChanges.fire(undefined)' is in publish at line 306. Consequently an outline that showed a current-source check can keep displaying that check after the source changes, even though inspect().model already reports reviewNeeded. The existing source-change test checks only the model and replaces EventEmitter.fire with a no-op.

summary: The close docstring still promises panel disposal although the new lease branch deliberately retains the reader panel.
fix: Describe closing frame delivery/listeners and releasing an external lease, with panel disposal limited to an internally owned viewport. Keep the ownership distinction explicit in this lifecycle entry point.
evidence: The motivating comment says 'Disposes only the owned panel during run cleanup'. The added branch at lines 122-125 instead executes 'this.record('viewport.lease-released'); this.lease.released(); return;' without calling panel.dispose; panel.dispose occurs only at line 127. Retaining the external reader is the explicit Cycle 6 ownership contract and is covered by the new leased-viewport test.

summary: StudyObservation is a new exported type alias with no consumer.
fix: Remove the unused alias; retain observationSchema and the existing StudyArchive-derived types actually used by capture, persistence, and presentation.
evidence: Line 32 declares 'export type StudyObservation = z.infer<typeof observationSchema>;'. Repository-wide rg for the complete symbol, excluding generated dist and node_modules, finds only this declaration; no implementation or test imports or references it.
